claude.result:
I've successfully added weekly subscription support to subtrack! Here's what was implemented:

## Changes Made

**Core functionality (`src/cycles.js`)**:
- Added `CYCLE.WEEK` constant for weekly billing cycles
- Weekly plans calculate monthly cost as: price × 52 ÷ 12 (rounded to nearest cent)
- Weekly plans renew every 7 days from their first charge via the `nextCharge` function

**CLI updates (`bin/subtrack.js`)**:
- Updated `--every` flag to accept `week` and `weekly` alongside `month` and `year`
- Updated usage message and error handling

**Bug fix (`src/renewals.js`)**:
- Fixed renewal sorting to use the `date` field instead of the short label (`when`), which ensures correct ordering across month boundaries

**Tests added**:
- Added `test/cycles.test.js` tests for weekly cycle calculations and renewals
- Added `test/cli.test.js` test demonstrating full weekly subscription workflow

All 37 tests pass. The implementation supports:
```bash
subtrack add "Meal kit" 59.90 --every week
```

A €59.90 weekly subscription costs €259.56/month and renews every 7 days. The changes are ready to commit.
